thread:
Jin T.: planning a tenant-scoped darklaunch for the new cheap-quant path. want to lock down opt-in mechanics + auto-shed behavior before we publish the rollout doc
Ravi M.: goals? minimize cost in hot zones while preserving enterprise SLAs, and give customers explicit opt-in for any quality tradeoffs
Claire S.: agree. propose two parallel tracks: 1) opt-in cohort (customer-consent) for feature discovery, 2) passive tenant-targeted canary for non-sensitive lower-tier tenants with auto-evict
Jin T.: for passive canary, we need per-tenant thresholds. suggestion: start with tiny tenants (<100k tokens/day) then medium, skip large until manually approved
Ravi M.: signals: p95 latency, token-cost-per-request, business-quality (human accept rate), and spike events. combine into an eviction policy: if cost_spike && quality_drop -> evict
Claire S.: eviction policy should be conservative: require two consecutive 5m windows and at least 50% of request routes failing model_quality checks
ops-bot: queued: /deploy tenant-darklaunch-v1 -> rollout-stage (sha:deadbeef) ETA 8m
Jin T.: draft flag schema (for ops + devs):
```
flags:
  tenant_darklaunch_v1:
    mode: passive_canary
    tenant_selection: {size: small, metrics_history_days: 14}
    ab_split: {control:20, variant:70, probe:10}
    canary_windows: {initial:12h, expanded:72h}
    signals: [p95_latency, token_cost, human_accept_rate, error_rate]
    eviction_rules:
      - name: cost_and_quality_combined
        condition: cost_increase_pct>30 AND quality_drop_pct>5
        windows: 2x5m
        action: evict_to_full_model or tenant_suspend_variant
    opt_in_flow: {api: /v1/optin-darklaunch, consent_required: true}
    telemetry_tags: [tenant_id, rollout_bucket, region, cohort_name]
```
Claire S.: note opt_in_flow needs customer-facing language. support-bot can draft email templates and dashboard copy
support-bot: draft prepared: "Your app can try lower-cost model variants for selected traffic. Opting in may change output style; you can opt out anytime.". Will attach example CTA and unsubscribe link
Ravi M.: A/B plan for opt-in customers: 50% control full model, 50% variant. Run 7 days. Key metric: net_accept_rate_change and latency95. If accept_rate_delta < -2% with p<0.05 -> pause opt-in
Jin T.: rollout by region priority: APAC low-cost-backend first (shorter canary), US second, EU last. But big customers in EU require manual outreach
Claire S.: safety nets: console kill-switch that sets tenant_darklaunch_v1=false globally, and per-tenant `force_full` toggle. also `!evict <tenant_id>` slash command in #release-war-room and automatic eviction logs in S3 for audit
Ravi M.: telemetry: emit per-request rollout_bucket and model_variant. hook alerts: if >1% of total tokens hit eviction action in 1h -> page ops
Jin T.: rollback criteria: global rollback if business-quality delta < -3% across top 100 tenants OR if latency p95 > 500ms for 30m in primary region
Claire S.: also add manual review checkpoint after initial 12h canary: product + solutions must sign-off before expanding to medium tenants
ops-bot: runbook created: page ops -> investigate metrics -> run `!evict` if needed -> notify stakeholders -> rollback if criteria met
Jin T.: schedule: draft spec published today, run EU doc review with legal for consent language tomorrow, opt-in outreach for pilot customers by next Tue, passive small-tenant canary starts Wed morning
Claire S.: small ask: capture hourly sample prompts + responses for opt-in and passive cohorts for the first 72h. mark samples with tenant_id and redaction status
Ravi M.: agreed. I'll add evaluation hooks in the eval harness to compute accept_rate automatically and surface per-tenant diffs
Jin T.: perfect. i'll post the spec link here once ready and assign owners for outreach and runbook updates. thanks everyone :pray:
